srt.policy.purpose: SRT global/pipeline policy inheritance, override, and rejection behavior

msr.purpose: Mahashivratri hero scenario with multi-language SRT ingest and Zipfian RTMP/SRT output fan-out

timestamp.bframe.migrationBlockedBy: needs transcodeProfileAxis for full matrix coverage

signal.control.purpose: AV signal-control knobs and signal-specific validation

fault.srt-output-stall.purpose: SRT destinations that stop taking data: bounded RSS against a frozen receiver, and the backpressured-but-connected stall path against a raw undrained SRT listener

srt.slow-peer.purpose: one genuinely slow APPLICATION SRT receiver (delivery paused, protocol alive) among healthy SRT outputs: healthy siblings must keep progressing and feed retention must stay bounded (WI2.5)

srt.admission.purpose: one SRT shard pool (ADMISSION_SHARDS at most) driven past its admission ceiling (Q-034): refused outputs report capacityRefused and send nothing, admitted outputs keep progressing, and no egress shard thread reaches 62% busy

fault.resilience.purpose: publisher disconnect, recovery, ingest lifecycle and cleanup coverage

srt-sink.purpose: standalone SRT sink peer on this host for multi-host packet-rate rungs (RESOURCE_SWEEP_SRT_PEER_HOSTS on the measuring host); reports its own counters and UDP drop counters

udp-drain.purpose: cheap wildcard UDP drain peer for substrate benchmarks: one receive socket per thread, counters and kernel drop counters on /state, so a sender result can be classified as receiver-limited or attributable

egress-duty.purpose: WI3.6 Stage D: one live Restream SRT egress fanout against the independent pinned srt-bench receiver on the lane, over a rated window; reports the pinned SRT egress shard thread CPU and the whole Restream process CPU per first-transmission DATA datagram, plus the receiver's whole-run loss/reconciliation fence. Manages its own lane network namespace (`ip netns exec`) and takes explicit binary paths, so it is not gated on the bench profile

substrate-pps.purpose: substrate UDP submission benchmark (compio vs native io_uring): one pinned sender CPU, 1000 destinations over the veth lane, preconstructed payload, queue-depth window; reports pps, pps/core and payload Gbit/s with the drain peer's counters deciding attribution

hls-push-duty.purpose: executor-isolation harness for HLS ingest: a baseline arm of `--base-publishers` RTMP publishers plus a treatment arm of `--hls-publishers` HLS push (TS or fMP4) publishers and/or `--pull-sessions` HLS pulls of a separate source pipeline's preview, each pipeline an ingest input and one RTMP sink output over a rated window; reports per-pipeline published/delivered packet counts and executor CPU per poll, the media executor's per-class window (thread CPU per poll, polls above 1/4/16 ms of CPU per session-minute, with `--poll-usage` the user/system and fault split), host vmstat/cgroup memory-event deltas and THP modes, per-output egress resync/stall/drop counters, wall-clock duration and host CPU count

hls-pull-duty.purpose: HLS pull ingest end to end: one pipeline fed by an FFmpeg RTMP publisher whose own `/hls/{pipeline}/master.m3u8` is pulled into a second pipeline by a `hlsPull` input (session cookie as a request header), with an RTMP sink output on the pull pipeline; checks the input round-trip, the `hls-pull` session label, published and delivered media, media-clock versus wall-clock keep-up, a reported failure and an unstopped pipeline for an unresolvable URL, and that disabling then re-enabling the input stops and restarts the pull; `--fail-unresolvable` runs the refusal variant

moq-dev-interop.purpose: MoQ against pinned moq-cli 0.14.7 and moq-relay 0.17.7 (scripts/dev/moq/fetch-moq-dev.sh): default moq-lite-06 + hang, or --ietf for explicit moqt-19 + MSF/LOC. RTMP-fed Restream egress to relay, catalog and negotiated-version assertions, CLI TS readback >=20 s with H.264/AAC, monotonic PTS and frame rate; authenticated origin readback and token refusal; relay crash/restart with uninterrupted RTMP sibling. Default ingest uses moq import ts directly; --ietf ingest uses a separate Restream source -> dedicated real relay -> Restream listener via a draft-19-only cluster dial, then RTMP readback >=8 s. --browsers retains Chromium/Firefox lite WebTransport playback of origin and relay with @moq/watch, including token-less origin refusal

moq-impairment.purpose: Headless MoQ subscriber under impairment: one RTMP-fed Restream pipeline publishes to the pinned moq-relay, then a loopback netem qdisc (2% loss, 200 ms delay, relay QUIC port only) is applied and `moq_subscriber` reads the broadcast over the production moq-net/hang path. Reports startup delay (catalog-ready to first media), video frames/keyframes, audio frames/bytes and A/V arrival skew (wall-clock gap between the two tracks delivering the same media instant, matched within 25 ms, after a 2 s join warmup); asserts keyframes > 0, audio > 0, p95 arrival skew <= 500 ms (maximum reported) and startup <= 10 s. Manual protocol evidence beside the unchanged browser E2E (no CI job runs it); needs the default private network namespace with CAP_NET_ADMIN

moq-moxygen-interop.purpose: MoQ egress through moxygen's moqrelayserver from a pinned commit (scripts/dev/moq/build-moxygen.sh), an independent C++ MOQT implementation: one RTMP-fed pipeline publishes MSF/LOC to one relay per draft (16 and 18), each offering only that draft. Asserts each relay negotiated the pinned draft and accepted the broadcast's PUBLISH_NAMESPACE, then the pinned moq CLI reads the broadcast back through moxygen on the same draft: TS readback >=10 s with H.264/AAC, monotonic PTS and frame rate. Manual protocol evidence (no CI job builds moxygen)

moq-relay-interop.purpose: Diagnostic-only MoQ egress and ingest against pinned MediaMTX v1.21.2; not a passing IETF gate because of the Q-091 SETUP, namespace discovery and LOC dialect mismatches. Exercises RTMP-fed MoQ egress plus RTMP sibling isolation, RTSP readback, and RTSP source forwarded over MoQ into Restream with RTMP readback. Use moq-dev-interop --ietf for the supported moqt-19 MSF/LOC gate; do not fork the MediaMTX dialect into production
